source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In the 2024 EWS send work, a server endpoint URI did not implement nsIMsgMailNewsUrl. Use instanceof when the mailnews interface is optional; it exposes the interface, so a second QueryInterface is redundant. Current send callbacks pass serverURI and secInfo separately. Preserve real security context at the transport boundary; the historical review accepted missing secInfo only with a follow-up, not as proof certificate overrides worked.
title: Treat a send server URI as nsIURI; guard optional mailnews interfaces
